procedures.title: Guided ultrasound capture (demo)
procedures.description: Demonstration content for the XR flow. It is not a clinical protocol and must be replaced by procedures curated and approved by a physician.

steps.title: Check the equipment
steps.instruction: Confirm that the probe, the gel and the tablet are within reach and that the probe is charged.

steps.title: Stabilize your position
steps.instruction: Secure your feet or a restraint so that both hands stay free and your body does not drift.

steps.title: Apply the gel
steps.instruction: Apply a thin layer of gel on the marked area shown on the body diagram in your headset.

steps.title: Locate the landmark
steps.instruction: Place the probe on the landmark highlighted in your headset and keep light, steady contact.

steps.title: Adjust the image
steps.instruction: Adjust depth and gain until the structure is centered and clear.

steps.title: Capture the image
steps.instruction: Hold still and capture the image. Capture a second one if the first moved.

steps.title: Review the image quality
steps.instruction: Compare the image with the quality guide. If it is unclear, mark this step as failed and repeat the capture.
steps.safetyNote: Image quality is part of the evidence. A poor image must not be used for an assessment.
